Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This Spirit II E-310 is my third weber grill.   My prior two weber grills were spirits also.  My first I had for 16 yrs and second fir 15 yrs.  I didn't wanted a good reliable grill but something that wouldn't break the bank.  The installation was somewhat confusing looking at the schematics of the manual.  I recommend downloading the app.  Once I did that,  it went together know problems.  I should mention after the grill was built, it is very sturdy.  Make sure when turning the gas on that the lid is open and all burners are in the off position.  Then turn the first burner on and push the igniter button.  If not done in this order,  the safety feature will slow gas flow and the grill will not heat up past 200 degrees.  I made this mistake and have not done since.   It is a good safety feature.  The grill heats up to 500 degrees pretty quick.  The porcelain grates are awesome to cook on and the grill heats evenly.  No hot spots   I grill out 3-4 times a week in the summer and fall and must say the grill is actually the best of the webers I've owned.   The ease of placing anything from meat to vegetables on the grill and shutting the lid and letting the grill do the work is quite fun.  The eveness of the cooking and flavors have been fantastic.  I would recommend this grill to anyone in the market for a nice looking, sturdy reliable grill.   Worth every penny.
Results.Title: Fantastic Grill

Results.ReviewText:
Bought this to replace a sunbeam grill we’ve had for more than 25 years. Parts were getting harder to find so it was time for a new grill. 

The Spirit II 3 burner is the perfect size for two people with the occasional family BBQ gathering. There is nothing fancy about this grill, it’s very basic, which is exactly what we were looking for. 

I bought this I assembled, and while assembly took about an hour, the instructions were straight forward. 

I enjoy the occasional tips from Weber regarding maintenance and grilling tips. 

The only downside is the grill was a little more expensive compared to others of the same size and options. However, with a 10 year warrantee and readily available parts, I think it should be worth it.
Results.Title: Nice grill
